== Course of events ==

In her wanderings through Wonderland, Alice encounters the Mouse and later discovers a Caterpillar perched upon a mushroom, smoking a hookah. These meetings precede an extraordinary and confounding situation that befalls her.

Alice becomes trapped within a small room in a most peculiar manner: her arms extend outward through the window, while her legs thrust upward through the chimney, leaving her caught between these two openings. Within the confines of this small space, she is unable to extricate herself from this remarkable predicament.

The resolution comes through the strange enchantments of Wonderland. Pebbles cast through the window transform into cakes by some magical agency; when Alice eats one of these cakes, she shrinks to her proper size and is able to free herself from the room. Following her escape, she encounters new circumstances in her ongoing adventures, becoming mistaken for a housemaid in service to the Rabbit.
